endorsements.name: Willem Vermeer
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-28452
endorsements.description: This affects the package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.12 from 0 and before 0.6.1; all versions of package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.11; the package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.13 from 0 and before 0.6.1. CSRF protection can be bypassed by forging a request that contains the same value for both the X-XSRF-TOKEN header and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie value, as the check in randomTokenCsrfProtection only checks that the two values are equal and non-empty.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.3)

endorsements.name: Willem Vermeer
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-7780
endorsements.description: This affects the package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.13 before 0.5.11; the package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.12 before 0.5.11; the package com.softwaremill.akka-http-session:core_2.11 before 0.5.11. For older versions, endpoints protected by randomTokenCsrfProtection could be bypassed with an empty X-XSRF-TOKEN header and an empty XSRF-TOKEN cookie.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.3)
